reviews.reason: The unit is wholly on printed p. 62, and the supplied asterisk before ቅዱስ is significant. 'Me' after 'answered' is not expressed in this unit. reviews.suggested_text: And he answered, saying, “This high mountain that you have seen, whose summit resembles the throne of the Lord, is his throne, where the Holy and Great Lord of Glory, the Eternal King, sits when he comes down to visit the earth for good.”
reviews.footnote_changes: Delete a and c. If b is retained, move its marker to 'for good' and shorten it to: 'Or, with goodness; the phrase describes a beneficent visitation.' Remove the out-of-order [c][b] cluster after 'Eternal King.'

reviews.suggested_text: “As for this fragrant tree, no mortal has authority to touch it until the great judgment, when vengeance is carried out upon all and brought to completion forever[a]. That tree will be given to the righteous and the humble.”
reviews.footnote_changes: Replace the existing notes with a localized note at the judgment clause: 'The wording concerning vengeance and completion is difficult; this rendering preserves both elements without identifying an otherwise unstated object of completion.' reviews.suggested_source_text: Bounded correction: replace ወአልሐዱ፡ with ወአሐዱ፡. Preserve ወ*ይፌጽም and the concluding demonstrative rather than emending them from the Greek.
